convergence_pattern.interpretation: S2 close required three fix cycles before semantic-review returned CLEAN. Cycle 1 surfaced 5 binding MAJORs about the original Sub-A/B/C work plus the orchestration co-mutations the original architecture under-specified. Cycle 2 (Sub-D/E/F: planner.md, phase_notifications.yaml, Step 4.5/Step 0.5) surfaced 7 binding MAJORs as the fix cascade revealed deeper coordination gaps. Cycle 3 (advisor-recommended doc-level fix per Path C: architecture section 6.0 coupling checklist + section 6.3 enumeration + restored OR-conjunctive guard) surfaced 4 binding MAJORs (pre_phase_advance_check.py wiring, trigger-31 timing divergence, section 6.0 example contradiction, broken cross-reference). Cycle 4 mechanical fixes converged on 1 MAJOR (section 6.3 row 4 not amended in lockstep with section 6.0 row 1 - exactly the kind of coordination error the section 6.0 checklist was meant to prevent). Cycle 5 closed cleanly. The pattern argues strongly for the section 6.0 coupling checklist's value at S4/S4.5/S5 (the next phase-runner-Step-editing stages).

delta_attribution.interpretation: Cost +3.02% and multiplier -0.135 are both feature-attributed to the S3 deliverable scope. The negative multiplier delta is the expected pattern for a manually-invokable skill: the new SKILL.md does not pull through the auto-dispatch graph (no Step 0.5 wiring at S3 — that lands at S4), so the average dispatch path length per artefact decreases when this skill is averaged in. convergence_pattern.interpretation: S3 closed in a single pass with no semantic-review binding (semantic-review is advisory at S3 per strategy section 5.4). One first-pass blocker from skill-check (plugin-commands missing /claim-coverage-audit row) was resolved by adding the entry to skills/plugin-commands/SKILL.md routing + catalog tables. Two first-pass blockers from catalog-check (README skills count 29 != 30; commands/claim-coverage-audit.md description not a prefix of catalog Purpose) were resolved by bumping README count to 30 and aligning the shim description with the catalog row's leading sentence. Calibrator first pass surfaced an over-cost reading caused by the default orchestrator classification of the new skill; the role_override fix dropped the cost from 6.4428 to 6.323805. Subsequent runs of all five gates returned zero blockers, zero majors, zero minors emitted by the calibrator (three known-FP metrics in baseline are unchanged: max_cyclomatic_complexity 39, max_subagent_chain_depth 22, parallelisable_fraction 0.073). The simplicity of S3 (additive document-only scope, no orchestration co-mutations, no schema bumps, no migration script) made the close clean compared to S2's five-cycle convergence.
